title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum on 1986-12-17
source: nak 300 mics w/cp4 shotguns > sony d-5 > mac

ai_review.summary: Nice post‑coma 1986 capture with clear vocals and only a hint of hiss
ai_review.review: The tape offers a pleasant listening experience – the mix is clear, especially the vocals, and the slight hiss is unobtrusive. It’s a solid representation of the band's 1986 sound for fans who enjoy that era.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review, but it rates the recording 4 stars and praises its clarity; no negative comments about performance, leading to a solid positive rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Minor hiss present but not distracting; vocals are clear and well‑presented in the mix.
